The Object Storage SDK retries failed requests up to 3 times with exponential backoff and full jitter by default.

user_input: How long are managed Postgres automated backups retained on the Standard plan?

The managed Postgres parameter group exposes a curated subset of postgresql.conf settings; max_connections scales with instance size.

Managed Postgres backups: automated daily snapshots are retained for 7 days on the Standard plan. Retention is configurable up to 35 days on the Pro plan, and point-in-time recovery covers the entire retention window.

The API gateway can route by path prefix or host header, and supports weighted canary routing between two backend versions.
Request and response bodies through the API gateway are capped at 10 MB; larger transfers should go directly to Object Storage.
The API gateway also enforces a 30-second upstream timeout; requests exceeding it receive HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout.

Rate limiting: when a project exceeds its configured request quota, the API gateway responds with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. The response includes a Retry-After header (in seconds) telling the client when the quota window resets.

IAM policy bindings are evaluated as a union of roles; there is no explicit deny, so the most permissive matching role wins.
The Viewer role grants read-only access to resource metadata but cannot modify IAM bindings or any credentials.
Audit logs record every IAM permission change, including who rotated or deleted a service account key and when.

Service account key rotation: the 'platform sa keys rotate' CLI command requires the iam.serviceAccountKeys.rotate permission. This permission is granted by the Service Account Admin role; the Viewer and Editor roles cannot rotate keys.

user_input: On which day of the month does the platform generate invoices for monthly billing?
response: For monthly billing, the platform generates the invoice on the first day of each calendar month, covering usage from the previous month.
retrieved_contexts: Spending alerts can be configured to notify project owners by email when monthly usage crosses 50%, 80%, and 100% of a set budget.
Promotional credits are applied to an invoice before the payment method is charged and expire 12 months after they are granted.
The platform accepts payment by credit card and, for Enterprise accounts, by invoice with net-30 wire transfer terms.
Tax is calculated at invoice time based on the billing address on file and itemized as a separate line on each invoice.

Billing cycle: invoices for monthly billing are generated on the first day of each calendar month and cover all metered usage from the previous month. Payment is due within 14 days of invoice generation.
